preparingForVisit.title: Appointment preparation
preparingForVisit.content: Confirm your appointment details before travelling. Contact the hospital if you are unsure where to report.

preparingForVisit.title: What to bring
preparingForVisit.content: Bring identification and any appointment or referral information available to you. IMSUTH-specific document requirements are awaiting approval.

preparingForVisit.title: Registration
preparingForVisit.content: Registration arrangements may vary by service. Ask the relevant hospital team for current guidance.

preparingForVisit.title: Medical records
preparingForVisit.content: Bring relevant medical information already in your possession when it may help the clinical team understand your care.

preparingForVisit.title: Referral information
preparingForVisit.content: If another healthcare professional referred you, bring the referral information provided to you.

faqs.question: Is an online appointment request automatically confirmed?
faqs.answer: No. A request is confirmed only after the hospital contacts you.

faqs.question: Should I use the appointment form for an emergency?
faqs.answer: No. Go directly to emergency care for urgent or life-threatening needs. Emergency services are available 24 hours.

faqs.question: What are the visiting hours?
faqs.answer: Approved visiting hours have not yet been published. Contact IMSUTH for current guidance.
